capabilities: Mark habits from a movable panel
Store habit completions as prefix/habit tags in the current document
extras: README is brief install-and-usage instructions with screenshots; no explanation of how habit data is displayed over time.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track recurring habits and see them at a glance while working in a note.
summary: Habit tracker that adds a panel for marking daily habits, storing each habit as a tag in the current note.
